Dear
Just tried to reach you on your mobile phone but unfortunately was not able to get a hold of you.
Andrea told me that you will be coming to Vienna and support us with the big conference on PANDEMICS in Geneva on
September 12th.
As discussed with Andrea, we suggest that you arrive on September

ed (Wednesday) in Vienna and leave from Geneva

back to New York on September 13th. I will be happy to book the flight for you from Vienna to Geneva (September 10),
so we can all be on the same flight, but I would kindly ask you to make the arrangements for your flight NY — Vienna and
Geneva — NY.
For accommodation I recommend the Hotel RADISSON BLU at Herrengasse: http://www.radissonblu.com/stylehotelvienna
It is right next to the IPI office.
Manon (copied on this e-mail) is organizing the seminar in Geneva right now and will send you an updated agenda. We
have also made hotel reservations for all participants at the Intercontinental in Geneva.
Please feel free to contact me anytime if you have any questions.
Looking forward to hearing back from you.
All the Best,
Johanna
